rv.q: The image is gorgeous; the joy is palpable.
This exceptional production should be your introduction to a play whose author audiences can no longer afford to overlook.
Let’s hope the run is extended, because it is hard to imagine a more beautifully rendered, exquisitely acted version of this rarely seen drama.
For a prime example: this powerful revival of Alice Childress’ Wedding Band .

Bradford and Sadoski have a crackling chemistry whether they're loving or fighting; the heart of the play lies their unstudied intimacy and the slow accretion of details that show just how intertwined their lives are.

cn.t: Alice Childress's long-overdue revival earns praise for its exquisite acting and beautiful rendering of an interracial love story set in 1918 South Carolina, with critics celebrating the breathtaking production and superb cast.
